text:
50세 남성 환자. Alcoholic cirrhosis로 인한 acute exacerbation of chronic liver failure로 입원.  
Vital signs: BP 95/60 mmHg, HR 115 bpm, RR 22 breaths/min, BT 37.5°C, SpO2 88% (room air).  
Severe jaundice 확인됨.  
Furosemide 40 mg IV BID 적용함.  
Oxygen 2L nasal cannula 유지함.  
Foley 유지함.  
Negative fluid balance 기록됨.  
Drowsy 상태 확인됨.  
Hepatology consult 요청함.
